CreateDomainNextVersionRequestMode.description:
- UNKNOWN: UNKNOWN mode will result in an invalid argument error. An API caller must specify one of the modes below.
 - INGEST_ALL_CONTENTS: All contents will be reprocessed and ingested.
Although this mode is equivalent to create domain using the CreateDomain default method, it's encouraged to use the CreateDomainNextVersion method to create your next domain version for clarity.
 - INGEST_CHANGED_CONTENTS: A Content is considered unchanged only if both of these are true:
  - It was discovered from the same KnowledgeDomainEntity uri, or KnowledgeDomainEntityWithSources source_location in the case of multiple sources.
  - It has the same source_location and detected revision as a Content object in the ancestor KnowledgeDomain.
Ingestion artifacts from unchanged contents are copied to the domain’s next version.
All other contents (ie. changed contents) will be reprocessed and ingested.
If a KnowledgeDomainEntity is not compatible with the KD succession, for example due to a different KnowledgeDomainEntity.label, an error will be returned. An API caller should use INGEST_ALL_CONTENTS mode instead.
 - INGEST_FAILED_CONTENTS: No revision or difference checks will be made for Contents or PriorKnowledge at the source_locations for any of the ContentGroups.
Only Contents that ended up in INGESTION_FAILED in the ancestor KD will be retried, and all previously successfully ingested Contents will be carried forward.
 - INGEST_SELECTED_CONTENTS: Ingest only the contents specified in in ContentGroupSource.Content `content` field. This will only re-ingest
previously ingested contents specified. No revision or difference checks will be made for Contents or PriorKnowledge
at the source_locations for any of the ContentGroups.
All previously successfully ingested Contents will be carried forward.

For example, if the content group has 5 contents all in the ingesting phase, then this would be [0, 0, 5, 0, 0, 0]. 3)  https://*.sharepoint.com URLs.
4)  https://*.box.com URLs.
5)  https://*.zendesk.com URLs.
6)  https://*.service-now.com URLs.
7)  https://*.s3.region.amazonaws.com URLs.
8)  https://*.atlassian.net URLs.
9)  https://*.my.salesforce.com or https://*.develop.my.salesforce.com URLs.
10) https://*.vimeo.com or vimeo.com URLs.
11) https://youtube.com URLs.

v1alpha1KnowledgeDomainEntityStatus.description:
Output only indicator of whether the knowledge domain can support conversation exchanges.

 - CONTENT_AWAIT: Initial value for a newly created KD; if knowledge domain was created with data.uri or data.contents, asynchronous status transition occurs to CONTENT_IDENTIFIED after a constituent Content Group and Contents are created; if knowledge domain was created without either of these, it remains in this status until an explicit PATCH with CONTENT_IDENTIFIED status is received.
 - CONTENT_IDENTIFIED: Starts an automated process of readying the content for conversation exchanges by ingesting each constituent content.
 - CONTENT_READY: Content is ingested and ready to support conversation exchanges.
 - CONTENT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Unable to support conversation exchanges on the content due to content problems; look for INGESTION_FAILED statuses to find out more details.
 - DECOMMISSIONED: No longer needed for conversation exchanges; will be removed from the system by ongoing housekeeping operations.
